verdict.summary: The layer system is sound: recomposite, swap-diff, one v3c grade and the shell lock all pass on A/B/C. Of the 12 defaults: 8 yes (framed-art, accent-sconces, rug, basket, magazine-holder, bowl, candle-holders, pendant as a product), 3 partial (curtains colour, floor-lamp lit shade, planter shape/texture), 1 no (vase size, new finding). Two R3 cut defects (pendant canopy, basket/pot edges) and the lamp toning are 0-token code fixes.
verdict.steps_4_7: May start, except: vase 2 / vase 3 wait for the vase default fix and the designer's position call; pendant 2 waits for the canopy re-cut fix in the cut code; bowl 2-3 and candle-holders 2-3 wait for WM-T2 (as planned). The designer's eye on the default scene is still the second half of the checkpoint.
verdict.partials_in_tool: Only behind HD_PUBLIC=0 and without a buy dot, as a temporary state; before the public site each one is fixed or gets an explicit owner exception (precedent EDR2 is an owner decision for the story rugs, not a general rule). The vase and the pendant layer are not 'partial' cases: they are fixed first.
